info.title: Alayn API
info.description:
The REST API behind the Alayn app. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send the returned JWT as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Outlet-scoped endpoints read the `x-outlet-id` header. Responses use `{ success, data }` (lists add `meta`); errors use `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`. This document covers a subset of the API and is generated from the backend's own specification.

**Errors**: every 4xx and 5xx response uses `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }`.

**Rate limits**: every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`. The whole API allows 1,000 requests per minute per IP; login, QR menus and feedback have stricter limits. A 429 response includes `Retry-After`.

**Versioning and deprecation**: the version is in the path (`/api/v1`). Breaking changes ship as a new version; a deprecated version keeps working for at least 6 months after the deprecation is announced on https://alaynai.com/api-docs#versioning.

BadRequest.description: The request failed validation (code VALIDATION_ERROR or BAD_REQUEST).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token.

Forbidden.description: The user's role or outlet doesn't allow this action.

NotFound.description: The resource doesn't exist or isn't visible to this outlet.
